title: Cassette-Editor: A Video Editing Agent That Edits the Way You Do
abstract: arXiv:2610.37690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language agents increasingly work by calling tools on a persistent artifact, such as a code repository, and the result of each call shapes their next step. Video editing is a demanding case of this pattern: what a frame shows depends on how every clip is trimmed, retimed, cropped, and nested, so knowledge about the footage holds only for particular uses of it, and an invalid edit can leave the timeline structurally broken. Existing video editing agents keep their edits valid with critic agents, reviewers, or restricted output formats. We present Cassette-Editor, a video editing agent with a deliberately simple interface: one tool reads the project and one tool writes to it. Every write passes through the same executor, rules, and commit service as the user's manual edits, and either commits atomically or is rejected with located diagnostics and repair options, while the model keeps the creative choices and decides how to recover. translated_title: Cassette-Editor：一个像你一样进行编辑的视频编辑智能体
translated_abstract: 语言智能体越来越多地通过在持久化工件（如代码仓库）上调用工具来工作，每次调用的结果都会决定它们的下一步行动。视频编辑是这种模式的一个高难度应用场景：一帧画面呈现的内容取决于每个片段如何被修剪、重新定时、裁剪和嵌套，因此关于素材的知识只对特定用途有效，而一次无效的编辑可能导致时间线在结构上崩溃。现有的视频编辑智能体通常借助批评智能体、审查机制或受限的输出格式来保持编辑的有效性。我们提出了 Cassette-Editor，一个采用刻意简洁接口的视频编辑智能体：仅用一个工具读取项目、一个工具写入项目。每一次写入操作都与用户的手动编辑一样，经过相同的执行器、规则和提交服务，要么原子性地提交，要么被拒绝并返回定位明确的诊断信息和修复选项，而模型则保留创意决策权并自行决定如何恢复。读取操作……
tldr: 提出了Cassette-Editor，一个通过“一读一写”极简接口让AI像人类一样直接编辑视频项目文件的智能体，所有AI编辑都经过与人工手动编辑相同的执行、规则和提交流程，从而以原子性提交和精准诊断保证时间线始终有效。
en_tdlr: Cassette-Editor is a video editing agent with a deliberately simple one-read, one-write tool interface, where every AI-generated edit passes through the same executor, rules, and commit service as manual edits, guaranteeing atomic commits with actionable diagnostics while the model keeps creative control.
